reasoning_content:
Now I need to set up the local Docker tags for demospipes and update the addon Dockerfiles to reference them instead of the container registry.

Next, I'll pull the prefect base image and start building the images in dependency order—frontend first, then the demospipes bases, then the 23 backend services, and finally the addon images. With limited parallelism, I'll start with the frontend to establish a baseline, then kick off a few backends in parallel to see where failures occur.

I should also check the .dockerignore files for each service to ensure they won't exclude critical files like pyproject.toml, and be mindful of the container memory limits since building heavy services like the ones with model downloads and large dependencies will need careful resource management.

action.command: cd /workspace && grep -rn '03-shared-services' --include='Dockerfile*' . ; echo "==== dockerignores:"; find . -name '.dockerignore' -not -path '*/.git/*' | wc -l; ls 02-backend/demospipes/api 02-backend/demospipes/core
